_comment: Connection registration for the pilot Supabase, consumed by:
This is what the execution gateway resolves when execute_sql runs.
Two credentials, deliberately distinct roles (G3, D-71.2):
- `dsn`         : the catalog-read introspection role, used by
- `execute_dsn` : the SELECT-only execution role, and the ONLY one
the gateway forwards, because it is the only one
An execute job with no query-marked credential fails closed rather
than falling back to the broader introspection role.
Both env names say which role they carry. That is deliberate: the
pilot previously read `env://SUPABASE_DSN`, a name that said only
which database it reached, and the value behind it was the estate's
`postgres` role holding BYPASSRLS. Renaming it forces the operator
to set a new variable to a new credential rather than leaving the
old one in place under a name that no longer describes it.
